recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It restores the work-group-approved FHIR-22657 source change in the active datatype page and avoids changing open type semantics because the Jira comment and current type configuration distinguish the Money datatype from the MoneyQuantity constraint.
issue_request: FHIR-22657 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It asked whether Money should be treated as a Quantity constraint rather than a datatype because the Quantity variations text and open type list were confusing; the approved resolution clarified that the constraint is MoneyQuantity, not Money, and directed the Quantity variations text to say there are two Quantity constraints and to add MoneyQuantity to the following table.
initial_application: Commit ec83d5b5057f1402bdeb77453f5d214806de6b8c explicitly listed FHIR-22657 in MnM non-substantive R5 changes and applied the requested datatype-page hunk: pluralizing the Quantity constraints text, adding MoneyQuantity to the Quantity constraints table, and removing the duplicate MoneyQuantity formal-definition table from the Money section.
additional_context: The next-day RatioRange datatype commit b9fd58139d35c8aa90083ae99a279c8a6d3dd854 unintentionally reversed the FHIR-22657 hunk while adding RatioRange. Current source/fhir.ini still lists Money as an active datatype and MoneyQuantity=Quantity, so Money should remain available as a datatype/open type while MoneyQuantity is documented as the Quantity-based constraint.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes.html to say there are two Quantity constraints, added MoneyQuantity to the table immediately under that line, pluralized the explanatory note, and left the Money section as explanatory prose without a second MoneyQuantity formal-definition table.
